overview: The Medford Comprehensive High School Building Committee met to review and approve various space efficiency recommendations for the new school building and voted to eliminate a proposed learn-to-swim pool addition from the project scope.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The committee approved the amended minutes of the September 10, 2026 meeting.

items.title: Core Academic Spaces
items.summary: The committee approved a space efficiency recommendation to reduce general academic classroom sizes from 950 to 900 square feet.

items.title: Medford Academy Space
items.summary: The committee approved reducing the two Medford Academy classrooms to 900 square feet to align with the general classroom size reduction.

items.title: Special Education Spaces
items.summary: The committee approved space efficiency plans for special education areas, which included classroom size adjustments and the elimination of two offices.

items.title: Chapter 74 Vocational Spaces
items.summary: The committee approved space adjustments and reductions across various Chapter 74 vocational program shops, including health assisting and carpentry.

items.title: Non-Chapter 74 Lab Spaces
items.summary: The committee approved maintaining the current non-vocational technology and innovation lab space plans with no overall square footage changes.

items.title: Media Center
items.summary: The committee approved the proposed media center space allocation designed in compliance with state guidelines.

items.title: Learn-to-Swim Pool Addition Alternate
items.summary: The committee voted to eliminate the proposed learn-to-swim basin addition from the project scope to avoid extra design costs and site layout constraints.
